rationale: The short thesis is intact and working: price is fading hard below session VWAP ($54.10) and the 9-EMA ($53.60), down-candles carry rising volume (5,600 and 3,575 on the last two 1m bars), and the tape is risk-off (SPY -0.28%, VIXY +1.21%) with no new headlines to disrupt the move. Adverse excursion has been only -0.18% versus the $54.42 invalidation, while the $52.65 target sits just above today's low of $52.60. A flip to long would be a counter-trend bet against clear intraday momentum while re-crossing a 17bp spread, and closing forfeits an intact trend, so holding toward the original target with the original stop is the highest-conviction action.
